##### Project general facts

Lagoon Views by RAK Properties offers an exceptional waterfront lifestyle with 20 low-rise residential buildings and thoughtfully designed studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments overlooking the lagoon. Its distinctive tiered architecture ensures beautiful, unobstructed water views, creating a bright and relaxing living environment.

Residents can enjoy an impressive range of amenities, including landscaped parks, recreational facilities, a gym, tennis courts, and relaxing spa experiences. The wider community also offers beautiful beaches, cafés, restaurants, retail outlets, and scenic walking and cycling paths, providing an excellent balance of leisure, convenience, and outdoor activities.

The residences feature designer finishes, carefully planned layouts, and practical details that enhance everyday comfort. Walk-in closets with shelving, insulated double-glazed windows, aluminum-framed glass windows, distinctive overhead lighting, and solid-core entrance doors add a refined touch to the homes.

##### Location description and benefits

Mina Al Arab is one of the most naturally abundant and tranquil coastal destinations in the region, where sea, sand, and greenery exist in rare balance. The area is defined by its island setting, calm waters, and preserved natural landscapes, offering a sense of escape while remaining well connected to the wider emirate.

The destination benefits from a thoughtfully planned waterfront environment that includes marinas, promenades, fine dining, leisure attractions, and resort-style amenities. Its layout encourages outdoor living, with open views, gentle sea breezes, and spaces designed for relaxation, recreation, and social connection. Privacy and accessibility coexist seamlessly, supporting a refined coastal lifestyle.

Ras Al Khaimah continues to gain recognition as a distinguished luxury and lifestyle destination, supported by strong infrastructure and sustainable growth. Mina Al Arab stands out for its serene character, natural beauty, and long-term appeal, offering a setting where exclusive beachfront living meets enduring value and authenticity.
